name: claude_code.default
_comment: What the Claude Code Action would have returned, in the shape the live path parses. Used only when the effective mode is MOCK. A missing fixture is a refusal, never an empty success.
_acceptance_note: Omitted on purpose: the worker derives one judgement per criterion from the packet, because the contract refuses COMPLETED unless every criterion is judged separately. A fixture may still override.
_governance_note: Positive assertions only. validate_result reads any false value here as the worker confessing a breach and refuses the return, so "model_called": false would stall the task. Set one false ON PURPOSE to exercise that refusal path.
